caption: The drawing consists of a symmetrical iron gate set between two large, rectangular masonry pillars or posts, each topped with a capstone featuring a pyramidal top. The iron gate is composed of two leaves, each with vertical bars, decorative floral and geometric motifs, and ornate wrought iron scrollwork throughout. The upper section of the gate features a repeating pattern of pointed arches and decorative finials, while a horizontal band with square floral designs separates the upper and lower portions. The lower section of each gate leaf displays a large circular design with radiating scrollwork and a central floral motif. The entire composition is rendered in black ink on an off-white background, with clear outlines and fine detailing in the ironwork, while the masonry pillars are shown in plain, unadorned lines with no shading or texture. Measurements are indicated along the base and right edge of the drawing.
title: Iron Fence and Gate
